data.one_liner: A customizable circular and radial context menu widget similar to Pinterest.
data.what_it_does: Provides a circular context menu triggered by user gestures like press, long press, or right click. It supports custom buttons, layouts, animations, and themes wrapped inside a canvas widget.
use_when: You want a circular or radial context menu similar to Pinterest.
You need a context menu that supports custom action buttons, angles, and themes.
avoid_when: You only need standard rectangular context menus provided by Material design.
You are not using a PieCanvas ancestor widget in your layout.
strengths: Highly customizable themes and button decorations.
Supports regular press, long press, and right-click triggers.
weaknesses: Requires wrapping pages or views inside a specific PieCanvas widget.
Limited to radial/circular context menu use cases.
